title: Ashby jobs
description: Minimal input: {"boards": ["openai"], "maxJobsPerBoard": 10}. $2 per 1000 delivered jobs, full descriptions and published compensation included. No start fee.

boards.title: Company job boards
boards.description: Required: company board tokens such as ["openai"] or HTTPS board URLs. Up to 20 boards. Individual job URLs and arbitrary company names are not supported. Searches only these boards, not a global jobs index. One returned job = one charge. Output company is the board token, not a resolved company name. updated_at is always null: Ashby exposes no edit timestamp.

maxJobsPerBoard.title: Maximum jobs per board
maxJobsPerBoard.description: 100 by default; 1-5000. Applied AFTER all filters and excluded IDs. For the newest 20 matching jobs from each company, pass 20. Fewer may exist. Sorted by source date descending.

maxResults.title: Maximum jobs in the run
maxResults.description: 1000 by default; 1-10000 across all boards. Stops early even if boards remain. With 10 here, the bill is at most $0.02. Use Apify run option maxTotalChargeUsd for a monetary cap.

titleKeywords.title: Job title keywords
titleKeywords.description: ["engineer", "developer"] matches either phrase in the job title, case-insensitively. Empty = all titles. Different filter fields combine with AND. Filtered jobs are free and do not use up the result cap.

locationKeywords.title: Location keywords
locationKeywords.description: ["London", "New York"] matches either phrase in any listed location, case-insensitively. Empty = anywhere. This is text matching, not a country boundary or eligibility check. Free filter applied before the cap.

departmentKeywords.title: Department keywords
departmentKeywords.description: ["Engineering"] matches any department containing that phrase. Empty = all departments; multiple phrases use OR. Free filter before the cap.

workplaceType.title: Workplace type
workplaceType.description: "any" (default) keeps all jobs. "remote", "hybrid" or "on_site" keeps only that classification. Hybrid is not treated as remote. Unknown classifications are excluded when a specific type is requested. Remote does not mean work from any country. Free filter.

sinceDate.title: Source date on or after
sinceDate.description: Empty = no date filter. Example "2026-10-01" includes jobs with published_at (publication, NOT last edit) on or after midnight UTC. Jobs without this source date are excluded. This does not detect first-seen jobs; use excludeJobIds for repeat runs. Free filter.

includeCompensation.title: Include published compensation
includeCompensation.description: true (default) includes published salary_ranges and compensation_raw at no extra charge. Missing pay is never estimated. false returns salary_ranges=[], compensation_raw=null and compensation_status="not_requested". Published pay comes from the same public board response.

onlyWithCompensation.title: Only jobs with published pay
onlyWithCompensation.description: false (default) includes jobs whether or not pay is published. true keeps only jobs with a numeric published pay range, requires includeCompensation=true, and filters BEFORE the cap. No extra charge; excluded jobs are free. Pay ranges may include OTE; inspect their labels and descriptions.

excludeJobIds.title: Previously delivered job IDs
excludeJobIds.description: ["previous-job-uuid"] excludes known job_id values. For multiple boards, prefer full job_key values from earlier output to avoid ID collisions. Maximum 10000. Empty = no exclusions. Excluded jobs cost nothing. Your workflow must save/pass this list; the actor does not schedule itself or retain monitoring state.
